title: Esther's Brave Choice
reflectionQuestion: Esther was frightened, but she did the brave thing anyway, and helped so many people. What is something brave that you have done, or want to do?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Esther). Courage thread + a female hero for register variety. Haman's plot is named abstractly ('a proud man wanted to harm God's people') with NO violence, no killing, no naming of Haman's fate -- per KID_STORY_PROMPT 3 (name danger calmly, emphasize rescue). Flag peril_threat_softened. Courage model is the right kind: 'scared but went anyway' (feeling fear AND being brave), not fearlessness -- routes an anxious child to brave_courage via the kid mood bridge (anxious->brave_courage). She prays first and is not alone. Indelible image = the king holding out the golden scepter (welcome / you are safe to come close). 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_ESTHER_BRAVE (strong, determined female) -- approved; NOTE deliberately NOT VOICE_LILY_WOLFF (banned for new authoring, feedback_voice_rules).
